audience: developers and ML teams who build with models on Together AI

useCases.title: Compare available models
useCases.text: The AI lists models with type, context length, license and per-token pricing. It finds, for example, the chat models with the longest context.

useCases.title: Check fine-tuning jobs and why one failed
useCases.text: The AI lists fine-tuning jobs with status and progress, opens one, and reads its event log. It also reads a training file's validation report.

useCases.title: Check batch job status and output files
useCases.text: The AI lists batch jobs with status and progress and opens one to see the output and error file ids. It points out the failed ones.

useCases.title: Review dedicated endpoints and hardware options
useCases.text: The AI lists endpoints with state and model, opens one to see its hardware, and lists the hardware options with price per minute.

useCases.title: Start or stop a dedicated endpoint
useCases.text: The AI starts a stopped endpoint, or stops a running one to end its per-minute billing.
